Confirm prepaid versus other Boost account types, renewal eligibility, taxes and supported payment channel. No transferable $30 card SKU is established.

description: Prepaid carrier with documented refill channels; pricing needs confirmation.
caveat: Official support describes refilling, but the current plan storefront could not be reliably retrieved. A 2025 parent-company announcement and legacy pages show different plan generations. name: Visible
description: Account-managed prepaid subscription service.
caveat: Visible accepts new subscribers, but its official payment workflow uses the member's logged-in account and saved payment methods. No conventional carrier refill PIN or generic reseller denomination was verified. Acceptance of prepaid bank cards is not evidence of Visible-branded refill cards. Keep checkout unavailable.

name: Net10
description: Legacy carrier retained for migration and account verification.
caveat: Official Net10 Rewards material retired that program in 2024 and directs customers toward Simple Mobile. Current new-customer activation and refill availability could not be verified from accessible primary sources; the main site returned HTTP 403. Treat as legacy/migration only, block new activations and all sales, and confirm the customer's actual carrier. Rewards closure alone does not prove service termination.

name: Page Plus
description: Legacy prepaid brand with indexed Standard PIN values.
caveat: The official indexed refill table lists $10/$25/$50/$80 Standard PINs, but direct access reached an unsupported-browser page. Revalidate current SKU availability and new-customer activation separately. The first three expire after 120 days; $80 is one year on Standard PAYG but 120 days as monthly-plan cash, so its validity is left null.

The main dynamic plan grid did not expose pricing in this research; confirm the annual offer, existing-customer renewal and actual service dates before sale.

name: Consumer Cellular
description: Monthly billed wireless service.
caveat: The official welcome guide describes billing in arrears for the preceding billing cycle. No prepaid refill-card product was verified. This is a conventional account bill, not a refill denomination catalog. New-customer service remains distinct from unsupported reseller refill fulfilment; seed no plans.

name: Walmart Family Mobile

caveat: Official support introduces $19.88/4GB and $34.88/20GB, and upgrades $24.88 to 8GB. It retires $29.88/$39.88 for new selection while allowing existing users to remain. Do not confuse the $19.88 add-a-line rate with the standalone 4GB plan. Verify network, renewal term and SKU.

name: Life Wireless
description: Eligibility-based Lifeline service with restricted account add-ons.
caveat: Lifeline requires eligibility and is distinct from ACP. ACP ended June 1, 2024; do not advertise ACP enrollment or benefits. Life Wireless says top-up availability, rates and allowances vary by state. Published $5/$10 international credits are restricted add-ons, not general domestic refill plans. No universal refill product is seeded.
